reason: I'd probably poke at the free 5 weeks, but 45 minutes a day with a baby isn't happening, and once that runs out I'd just go back to the free postpartum videos on YouTube. I don't pay for fitness, and the free part covers my first month anyway.
objection: There are already free postpartum and pelvic floor workouts on YouTube, so why pay? And I can't tell whether a mum of three knows any more about leaking and tummy gaps than a physio would.
would_change_my_mind: If a women's health physio had designed it or signed off on it, and it came in 15-minute sessions I could do while the baby naps, I'd pay the $19.99.
